entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I think I need to return something? I bought these shoes and I'm just so lost. The website was very confusing.
I can certainly help you look into a return. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
My name is Sarah Miller, and the order number is... V F 7 8 9 0 1. I think.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes, delivered 43 days ago. I can see you've had them for a little while. To best help you, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, um, a preference, I guess? They just feel wrong on my feet, and I think I got blisters the one time I wore them. I couldn't even figure out how the cleats are supposed to work. It's all too much. I just want a refund. Can't you just help me?

I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes are causing blisters and aren't comfortable for you. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up our return policy information for you.

Okay, I've confirmed it. Our policy allows for returns on standard items like these shoes for up to 90 days from the delivery date. Since you received them 43 days ago, you are well within the timeframe to return them for a full refund.
Oh! Really? That's a relief. So... what do I do? Do you send me something?

Yes, I've just processed the return authorization for you. I've sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. All you need to do is repackage the shoes, attach the label, and drop the box off at a post office. Once our warehouse receives it, we will process your full refund to the original payment method.
That's it? Wow, okay. That's much simpler than I expected. Thank you so much, Alex.
You are very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
